meta.subject: fixed another bug in bit shifting

en.summary: This commit corrects the direct-DRAM address aperture bit in DMA request generation after the prior mis-shifted fix.
why_it_counts: It changes live TileLink DMA address generation in both the read and write paths of the DUT.
The patch corrects the direct_dram high-bit offset from 1 << (5+32) to 1 << (4+32) in both StreamReaderCore and StreamWriter.
Selecting the wrong high address-region bit sends direct-memory traffic to the wrong aperture or unmapped region.
evidence: In src/main/scala/gemmini/DMA.scala, the direct_dram address mux changes from 1 << (5+32) to 1 << (4+32) in the reader path.
The same constant changes in the writer path under RegEnableThru, showing the bug affected both directions consistently.
The immediate predecessor commit had changed the constant to 1 << (5+32), so this commit is the stabilization of the same address-selection fix.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Some accelerators support a direct-memory mode by forcing a fixed high address-region selector bit above the translated physical address before issuing DMA traffic. If that selector bit is shifted by one position, direct-memory requests are sent to the wrong aperture even though the translated base address itself is correct. This is a concrete hardware address-generation bug because it changes which memory space is accessed on real transactions.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A DMA read or write is issued in the alternate direct-memory mode rather than the normal translated memory mode.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Move the fixed high address-region selector bit one place too high or too low when composing the outgoing DMA address.
portability_notes: Map this to the logic that tags a physical address for direct-attached DRAM, uncached memory, or an alternate memory aperture.
The important detail is not the numeric bit value in Gemmini, but the one-bit misplacement in the address-region selector.
If another DUT uses concatenation or address slicing instead of an added constant, inject the same off-by-one error in that encoding.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the DMA address composition logic for the direct-memory or alternate-aperture mode.
Change the fixed region-select bit so it targets the adjacent high-order position instead of the correct one.
Apply the same wrong selector in both the read and write request generators if they share the bug mechanism.
Run a direct-memory transfer and observe accesses hitting the wrong region or failing to reach the intended device memory.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: StreamReaderCore and StreamWriter direct_dram TL address composition
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the direct_dram address offset from 1 << (5+32) to 1 << (4+32) in both reader and writer TileLink request paths.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change the direct_dram mux constant from (1.U << (4+32)).asUInt back to (1.U << (5+32)).asUInt in both DMA address assignments.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Direct-memory DMA traffic is issued to the wrong address aperture, leading to incorrect reads, incorrect writes, or bus/access faults in direct_dram mode.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional change is the high-order address selector constant, which makes the bug mechanism very specific.
Both the reader and writer paths are corrected together, so the fault is a shared address-generation error rather than a one-off data-path issue.
The immediately preceding commit shows the same sites were actively being corrected, which grounds this as the final selector-bit fix.
notes: This bug only manifests when direct_dram or an equivalent alternate-memory mode is exercised.
A single-site injection in only one direction is possible, but the original fix corrected both read and write paths.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 DMA 请求生成中的 direct-DRAM 地址 aperture 位，在前一次移位修正仍然错误的基础上给出了正确值。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是 DUT 读写两条路径上的真实 TileLink DMA 地址生成逻辑。
补丁把 StreamReaderCore 和 StreamWriter 中 direct_dram 的高位偏移都从 1 << (5+32) 改成了 1 << (4+32)。
如果高位地址区域选择位错了，direct-memory 流量就会被送到错误的 aperture 或未映射区域。
evidence: 在 src/main/scala/gemmini/DMA.scala 中，direct_dram 地址 mux 在 reader 路径里从 1 << (5+32) 改成了 1 << (4+32)。
writer 路径中 RegEnableThru 包裹的同一个常量也做了相同修改，说明 bug 对两个方向都一致存在。
紧邻的前一个提交刚把该常量改成 1 << (5+32)，因此本提交可以看作同一地址选择修复的稳定版本。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 有些加速器会在发出 DMA 请求前，把一个固定的高位地址区域选择位叠加到已经完成地址翻译的物理地址上，以进入 direct-memory 模式。如果这个选择位被错移了一位，那么即使基础物理地址本身是正确的，direct-memory 请求也会被送往错误的地址 aperture。这是明确的硬件地址生成错误，因为它会改变真实事务访问的内存空间。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: DMA 读或写使用了 direct-memory 或其他备用地址空间模式，而不是普通翻译后的内存模式。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在构造 DMA 输出地址时，把固定的高位地址区域选择位向上或向下错移一位。
portability_notes: 把它映射到负责给 direct-attached DRAM、uncached memory 或其他备用 aperture 打标签的地址生成逻辑。
重要的不是 Gemmini 中具体是哪一位，而是地址区域选择位发生了一位偏移。
如果其他 DUT 通过拼接或切片来编码该地址模式，而不是加一个常量，就在对应编码逻辑中注入同样的 off-by-one 错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 direct-memory 或备用 aperture 模式下的 DMA 地址生成逻辑。
修改固定的区域选择位，使其落到相邻的高位位置而不是正确位置。
如果读写请求生成器共享该机理，就在两个方向上都应用同一个错误选择位。
运行 direct-memory 传输，观察访问是否命中了错误区域，或者无法到达目标设备内存。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: StreamReaderCore 与 StreamWriter 中 direct_dram 的 TL 地址组装
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 reader 和 writer 两条 TileLink 请求路径中的 direct_dram 地址偏移从 1 << (5+32) 改成了 1 << (4+32)。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把两个 DMA 地址赋值中的 direct_dram 常量从 (1.U << (4+32)).asUInt 改回 (1.U << (5+32)).asUInt。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 direct_dram 模式下，DMA 流量会被发往错误的地址 aperture，导致读错、写错，或者产生总线/访问故障。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁唯一的功能性变化就是高位地址选择常量，因此 bug 机理非常具体。
reader 和 writer 路径同时被修正，说明这是共享的地址生成错误，而不是孤立的数据通路问题。
紧邻的前一个提交也在修正同一位置，进一步说明本提交才是稳定下来的选择位修复。
notes: 这个 bug 只有在启用 direct_dram 或等价备用内存模式时才会暴露。
如果只想做单点注入，也可以只改一个方向，但原始修复同时覆盖了读和写。
